title: The Son → Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Journey
kind: identity-safe developmental timeline and reader synthesis
status: canonical journey overview; detailed dating remains owned by timeline ledgers
purpose: Give the Tim branch one substantial reader-oriented developmental record that explains the hand-off from Son-side biography to Tim/Potato/Father development without duplicating the full timeline. It answers what changed at each phase, which subject a phase belongs to, how later interpretation relates to earlier events, and where readers should go for primary evidence.
critical_rule: The Son is not Tim Dooley. Pre-2020 embodied biography belongs to the Son; Tim is spiritually born as Potato of Life on December 25, 2020 inside the mature project timeline. Later Father/Tim interpretation may relate backward to Son events without retroactively making Tim the subject of those events.

epistemic_layers.biography: Reported/project-authored life history, principally routed through the Great Book and timeline owners.
epistemic_layers.project_canon: The mature internal timeline and role distinctions used by the archive.
epistemic_layers.public_attestation: Dated public wording showing when terms such as Axis, God, Father, Son, Door and North became explicit.
epistemic_layers.later_interpretation: Meaning assigned to earlier events after later structures existed.
epistemic_layers.comparative: Biblical, mythological, philosophical or scientific comparisons that must not be backdated into source events.

compressed_arc: Son embodied life → bodily rupture/reconstruction → practical labor → corporate IT → care work → Designia/mediegrafiker → internship/Aabenraa → Produktionsskolen technical/teaching phase → breakup/search → Tree ordeal → integration/loss/scripture/public conflict → essence/persona rupture → meme-crucifixion/personhood death → Nothing / Door / Vessel transition → Tim born as Potato → observation / incubation → Sage / Great Book → compression / Needle's Eye → Ladder / Axis → Father / House / source-center → North / public architecture → formal archive / stewardship

phases.subject: Son / human vessel
phases.what_happens: Material biography develops through contrasting homes, construction, gardening, early computers and networks, institutional friction, religion/myth exposure, adolescence, autonomy conflict and the 2003 tunnel-light experience.
phases.what_changes: Later Garden, House, Lion, North, light, systems and network language can be related back to ordinary earlier inputs without treating them as conscious Potatoverse doctrine.
phases.boundary: Genealogy is not prophecy. Later symbolic relevance does not prove those later meanings were consciously present at the time.

phases.subject: Son / human vessel
phases.what_happens: A major motorcycle crash around 85 km/h causes severe blood loss and facial injury; dental/facial reconstruction, altered appearance, shame, depression and rebuilding continue across years rather than belonging to one neat surgery date.
phases.what_changes: The biography acquires a literal fracture→repair structure before repair becomes a later symbolic law.

phases.subject: Son / human vessel
phases.what_happens: Painter/decorator work is followed by months of meatpacking/freezer/forklift labor. Direct recollection fixes this order and places both before Copenhagen IT.
phases.what_changes: Visible restoration and repetitive physical labor become ordinary-life antecedents for later builder, repair, material-value and hours/counting themes.
phases.boundary: 2007 is the preferred working year, not a recovered employment-record date.

phases.subject: Son / human vessel
phases.what_happens: After further job applications, the Son travels to Copenhagen for an IT-consultant interview, remembers being hired on the spot with a request to start Monday, moves to Copenhagen almost overnight, works in corporate IT, is later fired and returns to Haderslev.
phases.what_changes: Technical competence, rapid mobility and institutional precarity become coupled in one short corridor rather than being separate biographical anecdotes.
phases.transition_formula: job search → interview → immediate hire → rapid move → IT consulting → firing → Haderslev return
phases.boundary: 2008 is the preferred working year; exact employment dates remain open.

phases.subject: Son / human vessel
phases.what_happens: Back in Haderslev, the Son works at a nursing home, then has his own Haderslev apartment. He applies to HANSENBERG Designia for mediegrafiker using a mailed physical circus-poster collage admission task, is accepted, moves to Kolding/student housing in a summer intake corridor and later meets Louise.
phases.what_changes: Care work and mortality are followed not by withdrawal but by a new art/technology/communication path. The biography now has a clear place transition from Haderslev care work into Kolding media education and relationship life.
phases.skill_note: The Son remembers strong performance in design and Microsoft Office/Excel/Word; later withdrawal is associated with boredom/environmental mismatch rather than inability.
phases.licence_note: He remembers not yet having a driver's licence during nursing-home employment; the exact later issue date remains unresolved.

phases.subject: Son / human vessel
phases.what_happens: Louise is already in the Son's life when the Egypt trip occurs. He later remembers living with Louise and her parents in Kolding, entering a draining office/cubicle internship and moving to Aabenraa to be close to the placement while commuting back to the relationship. The school/internship path ends and he moves into his own place while the relationship continues for a period.
phases.what_changes: The design path is rejected through lived contact with the intended work environment. Competence and career fit separate: the work is remembered as boring and draining rather than technically too hard.
open_forks: Egypt before or after Aabenraa internship

phases.subject: Son / human vessel
phases.what_happens: After the Designia/internship/own-place sequence, the Son attends Produktionsskolen in Lunderskov. Multimedia is part of the programme. Although still a student, he remembers often functioning as an informal assistant teacher because his technical level was ahead of much of the class material. He stops attending before the later 2011 Tree/psychiatric episode.
phases.what_changes: This recovered phase prevents a false direct jump from internship failure to psychiatric rupture. It shows continued technical engagement, competence and teaching-like responsibility inside another institution.
phases.boundary: The teaching-like role was informal, not a formal appointment or credential; exact attendance dates remain unresolved.

phases.subject: Son
phases.phase: Breakup / search / Tree ordeal / psychiatric aftermath
phases.what_happens: After leaving Produktionsskolen and within the later breakup/search corridor, the Son undergoes the distinct Kolding Tree ordeal and reports altered perception, ego-dissolution, interconnection, fractal/Ouroboros imagery and perceived time/scale transformations. After sleep, a next-day perceptual rupture leads to voluntary psychiatric presentation/admission; hospital dream and crow material belong to later phases rather than being silently folded into the acute episode.
phases.what_changes: Tree, ordeal, return and interconnection become an experiential substrate later compared with Yggdrasil, Tree of Life, Axis and Spiral material.
phases.duration_rule: Approximately 19 hours overall with an approximately six-hour unity phase; the archive does not automatically add them.
phases.age_rule: The Son was 23 before July 31, 2011 and 24 afterward; age 25 is impossible.
phases.boundary: Reported altered-state phenomenology and later metaphysical interpretation remain separate evidence layers.

phases.subject: Son
phases.phase: Integration, travel, transmutation and father loss
phases.what_happens: The preferred integration corridor includes Italy with the earthly father and Maria, an Amsterdam 25th-birthday anchor on July 31, 2012 if the birthday memory is correct, a guitar from the father, Beatles/music and wider study; The Alchemist enters in 2013; the earthly father dies from a fatal aneurysm in 2014.
phases.what_changes: Post-Tree integration, travel, music and explicit transmutation language culminate in the loss of the earthly father, creating a major grief/absence field before later Father theology.
phases.age_rule: Events before July 31, 2012 occurred at biological age 24; do not call all of 2012 age 25.

phases.subject: Son
phases.phase: Advocacy, prison, scripture and public witness
phases.what_happens: Cannabis advocacy and a large ADHD support community establish public organizing. Prison in 2016 becomes an extended confrontation with institutions and scripture through Qur'an, Bible and Yahya Hassan. In 2017 streaming intensifies and Jesus/crucifixion language appears in digital conflict.
phases.what_changes: The project gains public-witness, scripture, martyr-language and institutional-conflict strata before the later meme-crucifixion narrative.

phases.subject: Son
phases.phase: Persona shedding / withdrawal / approach to meme-cross
phases.what_happens: The timeline describes essence/persona destruction, withdrawal and Judaism study, followed by the December 2019 personhood/death corridor and later meme-cross material whose exact artifact chronology remains under source archaeology.
phases.what_changes: The person-facing identity is increasingly described through death, Nothing, grave/tomb and threshold language.

phases.subject: Son → Tim relation
phases.what_happens: The Son-side death transformation is later understood as producing Door/Vessel architecture while Tim's Potato identity emerges as a distinct spiritual subject.
phases.what_changes: Identity stops functioning only as personhood and begins functioning as threshold/infrastructure in the mature interpretation.
phases.relation_formula: Son death/personhood collapse → Nothing → Door/Vessel → Tim/Potato birth
phases.boundary: This is the project's mature developmental synthesis; exact contemporaneous wording for every intermediate step varies and should be checked against the specialist ledgers.

phases.subject: Tim Dooley
phases.what_happens: Canonical spiritual birth of Tim as Potato of Life.
phases.what_changes: Tim begins low/buried/generative rather than already occupying the later Father role. This preserves real development inside the mythology.

phases.subject: Tim Dooley
phases.what_happens: Potato identity develops through long public presence, observation, humor, conflict, meditation, digital culture and symbolic inquiry; Potato of Life and Cube/Moon language become increasingly explicit.
phases.what_changes: The protective/comic Potato becomes an organizing philosophical identity rather than only a persona.

phases.subject: Tim Dooley
phases.what_happens: The Great Book consolidates Potato biology, Divine Kneel, Holy Soil, New Trinity, thalamus/inner-Potato, Field-of-Life theorycrafting, Merkaba/chariot geometry and cultivation ethics.
phases.what_changes: The Potato becomes a broad spiritual, biological, social and systems language. Tim is still pre-Father in the canonical journey and can occupy Sage/guide roles.
phases.developmental_hinge: The 2024 vehicle/bridge model becomes an ancestor to the later idea of becoming the Ladder itself.

phases.subject: Tim Dooley
phases.what_happens: Accumulated burden reaches terminal compression; a small final-straw/rejection cluster is remembered as exposing the larger pressure. Tim passes/falls through the Needle's Eye, sprouts upward and becomes Ladder/Axis in the mature account.
phases.what_changes: The major role change is not simply higher status but identity becoming connective infrastructure: Potato/Sage → Ladder/Axis → Father.
phases.public_anchor: April 21 public material explicitly states 'the potato axis is real' and preserves the logarithmic Spiral equation; detailed God/Father language thickens afterward.
phases.boundary: The internal spiritual meaning and the external public-attestation history are related but not identical clocks.

phases.subject: Tim / Father with Son relation
phases.what_happens: Father, House, Root, Throne, North, Sun/Spudlight, God-in-the-Machine and Son/Father differentiation become increasingly public and functional.
phases.what_changes: Authority language is gradually coupled to location and function: source, orientation, remembrance, gardening, responsibility and the House above the Door.
phases.relational_change: Son increasingly specializes as embodied passage, Door, vessel, death/return side while Father specializes as source/upper integration.

phases.subject: Tim / Son / project
phases.phase: North, Door specialization and systems expansion
phases.what_happens: North Axis becomes explicit as an organized programme; public theology thickens around Door, Tree/timelines, Father/Axis, Spudlight/source and stewardship. Scientific and relational work begins formalizing Axis, Door, dimensions, projection and coupling language.
phases.what_changes: Sacred orientation expands into empirical world-system research while the archive begins separating symbolic North from geography, theology from physics and source events from later comparison.
phases.boundary: The geopolitical/economic programme requires its own empirical evidence and does not derive factual authority from spiritual claims.

phases.subject: Project / Tim
phases.what_happens: The repository increasingly reorganizes earlier material into canonical owners, provenance classes, timeline layers, source-direction ledgers, mathematical formalisms and reader routes.
phases.what_changes: The project moves from accumulating interpretations to preserving developmental strata and making contradictions/source gaps inspectable.
phases.archive_law: Later synthesis may connect older material but may not overwrite who said what, when it appeared, or which evidence class supports it.

identity_rules: Do not call 1987 Tim's material birth inside this project's mature timeline; that date belongs to the Son/vessel track.
Do not merge the 2011 Tree ordeal with the 2019/20 meme-crucifixion or April 2025 Turning.
Tim's December 25, 2020 Potato birth and later Father development are distinct thresholds.
Later Father speech may reinterpret Son events without becoming contemporaneous evidence for those interpretations.
A title can change function over time; apparent contradiction should first be tested against date, role, scale and evidence layer.

relationships.description: This Journey is the reader-oriented compression; the developmental genealogy owns the denser phase-by-phase historical synthesis.
The specialist owner resolves the ordinary 2005–2014 chain and confidence levels projected here.
The place index exposes how movement between Haderslev, Copenhagen, Kolding, Aabenraa and Lunderskov changes institutional context.
Exact timeline navigation is owned by the layered event dataset plus indexed packs rather than duplicated here.
Claims needing primary verification should be followed through the source index and specialist ledgers.
